origin: Prema Racing, while now a dominant force in junior formulae, began humbly in the late 1980s as a passion project of Angelo Rosin. Rosin, a former karting mechanic with an unyielding love for motorsport, dreamed of creating a team that could nurture young Italian talent. He started small, running a single Formula Ford car out of a cramped workshop in Vicenza. The early years were a struggle, marked by shoestring budgets, late nights, and a relentless pursuit of sponsors. A breakthrough came in the mid-90s when local businessman Graziano Rampazzo, impressed by Rosin's dedication, invested in the team, allowing them to expand their operations and enter Formula Renault.
philosophy: Prema's philosophy revolves around providing young drivers with a structured and professional environment to develop their skills. Their approach to car development is meticulous, focusing on data analysis and driver feedback to continuously improve performance. Team culture emphasizes discipline, teamwork, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, instilling in drivers the values necessary for success at the highest levels of motorsport.
achievements: Multiple Formula Renault championships in the late 1990s and early 2000s
Victories in the Italian Formula Three Championship
Development of several drivers who went on to compete in Formula One

teamPrincipal.name: Angelo Rosin
teamPrincipal.background: Angelo Rosin, the founder and team principal, is the heart and soul of Prema Racing. His hands-on approach and unwavering commitment to developing young talent have been instrumental in the team's success.

keyFigures.name: Graziano Rampazzo
keyFigures.description: Rampazzo's financial backing and business acumen provided the stability and resources needed for Prema to grow and compete at a higher level.

headquarters: Prema Racing is based in Vicenza, Italy. Their facilities, while functional, are relatively basic compared to some of the larger teams, reflecting their focus on investing in equipment and personnel rather than lavish infrastructure.
fanBase: Prema enjoys a loyal fanbase in Italy, particularly among motorsport enthusiasts who appreciate their commitment to nurturing young Italian drivers. Many fans follow the team's progress closely, hoping to see their home-grown talent succeed on the international stage.
